name: Get Static Lists
summary: Lists the static lists in your instance with their IDs — the first step when you need a list ID for adding/removing leads.
whenToUse: When you need to find the numeric ID of a static list (lists have human names in the UI but the API works with IDs).

response.description: One entry per static list with its id, name, and creation info.

notes: Static lists are 'flat' lists you manage by hand — different from Smart Lists, which are filter-based.
